I will try to get some DAP from the cooperative if it comes in time, but only a small amount because the plot is small and the land is not mine — I do not want to spend too much on rented ground. I will put manure from my animals on the field like I always do, and use the seed I saved from last year because improved sorghum seed is hard to find here and costs too much. My wife and children will help me weed and harvest, and I do not need to hire anyone for such a small plot.
